description: Uploads stream directly to the api-core blobstore; downloads stream back preserving original filename; image thumbnails are generated server-side at ingest; the relational metadata store uses migrations and is never recreated on schema change.

requirements.description: File uploads are streamed directly to the api-core blobstore without buffering the entire file in the hub server's memory. Downloads stream back from the blobstore to the client with the original filename preserved in the Content-Disposition header. Image thumbnails are generated server-side at ingest time and stored as a derived blob linked to the item metadata. The relational metadata store uses versioned schema migrations and is never recreated or dropped on schema change.
requirements.title: Streaming Blob Storage and Download via api-core

validation.notes: Unit test: upload handler pipes request body reader directly to blobstore writer without intermediate buffer accumulation (verified with mock blobstore seam tracking max concurrent memory usage)
Unit test: download handler sets Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='<original_filename>' header from item metadata
Unit test: thumbnail generation is invoked for image MIME types and skipped for non-image types
Unit test: migration runner refuses to drop or recreate tables; only additive ALTER/CREATE statements are permitted (linting rule)
Unit test: blobstore seam interface is implemented by exactly one production adapter and is the sole upload/download path
Integration test: upload a 50 MB file; assert memory usage of hub process does not exceed 20 MB above baseline during transfer
Integration test: download the 50 MB file; assert Content-Disposition header contains original filename
Integration test: run all pending migrations on a fresh schema; assert no table recreation in migration SQL logs
Integration test: run all pending migrations on a schema with existing data; assert data is preserved
Streaming upload: hub memory overhead must not exceed 20 MB for a 100 MB file transfer
Streaming download: first byte delivered to client within 500 ms of download request for files already in blobstore
Playbook: upload a PNG image; confirm thumbnail renders in Receive pane; download the file; confirm original filename is preserved

title: Streaming Storage via api-core
